newsitem.title: USA: Planning Sciences ADRs down after warning.
newsitem.headline: Planning Sciences ADRs down after warning.

text.p: Planning Sciences International Plc's ADRs slumped on Monday amid concerns about the British client/server software company's first-quarter results.

The company's American Depositary Receipts were off 5/8 at 4-1/8 in early afternoon after falling as low as 3-1/4 during the morning. Volume was heavier than average at 928,700 ADRs, with trade dominated by three blocks of 249,000 shares each.
Further details on the block trades were not immediately available.
The company's ADRs have fallen from a high of about 32 in May 1996, shortly after their initial public offering.
